claim: For the Laplacian \(-\mathrm d^2/\mathrm dx^2\) on an interval \([0,\ell]\), \(\ell>0\), with independent nonzero real Robin parameters \(\lambda_0,\lambda_\ell\) imposed as \(\psi'(0)+\lambda_0\psi(0)=0\) and \(-\psi'(\ell)+\lambda_\ell\psi(\ell)=0\), let \(g_0\) be the spectral multiplicity of the zero eigenvalue, \(N=\operatorname{ord}_{k=0}F(k)\) the secular multiplicity for \[F(k)=1-\frac{(\lambda_0-\mathrm i k)(\lambda_\ell-\mathrm i k)}{(\lambda_0+\mathrm i k)(\lambda_\ell+\mathrm i k)}\,\mathrm e^{2\mathrm i k\ell},\] and \(\widetilde N\) the zero-energy scattering multiplicity of Bolte--Egger--Steiner. Then the complete classification is \[g_0=1\iff \ell=\lambda_0^{-1}+\lambda_\ell^{-1},\qquad \widetilde N=1\ \text{always},\qquad N=3\iff g_0=1,\] with \(g_0=0\) and \(N=1\) otherwise. On the resonance surface the zero mode is proportional to \(1-\lambda_0x\), and the cubic coefficient is nonzero because \(\lambda_0^{-3}+\lambda_\ell^{-3}=\ell(\lambda_0^2-\lambda_0\lambda_\ell+\lambda_\ell^2)/(\lambda_0^2\lambda_\ell^2)>0\). Consequently the trace-formula combination stays \(g_0-N/2=-1/2=\tfrac14\operatorname{tr}\mathfrak S_0\) throughout the full asymmetric two-parameter family.

The originality claim is only the complete asymmetric two-parameter classification of the one-edge anomaly introduced in the source paper.

title: Asymmetric Robin interval: exact zero-mode resonance and cubic secular multiplicity jump
